Led a team of 5 engineers in designing scalable computer vision solutions for industry applications
Optimized deep learning model inference speed by 40% using TensorRT, ONNX Runtime, and C++ bindings
Implemented automated MLOps pipelines reducing deployment cycle times by 60%
Successfully delivered 15+ production AI/CV projects across smart infrastructure, surveillance, and defect detection

projects.name: Smart-Annotator
projects.title: Smart-Annotator
projects.problem: Manual image quality control and annotation review is slow, error-prone, and inconsistent.
projects.fix: Cross-platform React + Electron desktop tool with Flask backend for XML/JSON polygon & bounding box quality control and auto-save.
projects.longDescription: Smart-Annotator is a cross-platform desktop application built with React and Electron, featuring a Flask backend for robust image annotation quality control. Supports detection (XML) and segmentation (JSON/LabelMe) formats, per-object attributes, auto-save, and an interactive canvas with zoom/pan capabilities.
features: Per-object attributes (JSON + XML) with isolated updates
Electron-first save paths with backend fallback
Auto-save and unified Ctrl+S for geometry and attributes
Interactive canvas with polygons, bounding boxes, zoom/pan
projects.zahid: Built for high-volume dataset annotation and quality verification in computer vision workflows.

projects.name: Road Assets Condition Index
projects.title: Road Assets Condition Index
projects.problem: Inspecting roadside infrastructure manually takes thousands of hours and yields inaccurate asset condition scores.
projects.fix: Automated computer vision system using YOLO and GPS metadata to detect roadside assets, tag coordinates, and compute Asset Condition Index (ACI).
projects.longDescription: A computer vision solution for smart infrastructure management. The system automatically detects various roadside assets (traffic signs, safety barriers, street lights), estimates location using GPS metadata, and computes an Asset Condition Index (ACI) based on deep learning visual analysis.
projects.zahid: Automates smart municipal infrastructure surveys with real-time GPS mapping.

projects.name: Road Cracks Detection & PCI Assessment
projects.title: Road Cracks Detection & PCI Assessment
projects.problem: Pavement degradation is diagnosed late, causing expensive full-road reconstructions.
projects.fix: Deep learning system using Faster R-CNN & YOLO to categorize pavement cracks, compute Pavement Condition Index (PCI), and generate repair bill of quantities.
projects.longDescription: An AI-powered solution for automated road crack detection and classification using computer vision. The system analyzes road surface images, identifies crack types (longitudinal, transverse, alligator), calculates PCI scores, and suggests optimal maintenance strategies.
projects.zahid: Identifies early pavement defects to save millions in municipal maintenance costs.

projects.name: AI-Powered Face Recognition System
projects.title: AI-Powered Face Recognition System
projects.problem: Traditional attendance and access control systems suffer from proxy attendance and spoofing attacks.
projects.fix: Real-time deep learning facial detection and recognition system with anti-spoofing liveness detection and automated web admin portal.
projects.longDescription: Leverages state-of-the-art deep learning models to provide real-time face detection and recognition capabilities. Handles multiple faces simultaneously with anti-spoofing and liveness checks for secure access control.
projects.zahid: Delivers biometric security with sub-second facial verification.

projects.name: Intelligent Traffic Monitoring System
projects.title: Intelligent Traffic Monitoring System
projects.problem: City traffic controllers lack real-time visibility into traffic density, speed violations, and vehicle counts.
projects.fix: YOLO-powered computer vision pipeline analyzing multi-lane video streams to count vehicles, estimate speeds, and recognize license plates.
projects.longDescription: An intelligent traffic monitoring system that uses YOLO object detection and computer vision techniques to analyze traffic patterns, count vehicles, estimate speeds, and provide real-time insights.
projects.zahid: Processes multi-camera streams to assist smart traffic management.

projects.name: Obfuscated Malware Detection System
projects.title: Obfuscated Malware Detection System
projects.problem: Modern malware authors use packing, encryption, and obfuscation to evade traditional signature-based antivirus engines.
projects.fix: AI/ML classification pipeline analyzing RAM memory dumps, API call sequences, and PE header features to detect obfuscated malware variants.
projects.longDescription: A machine learning cybersecurity framework designed to detect obfuscated and packed malware variants. Features automated feature extraction from memory dumps, API call tracing, and evaluation across multiple ML classifier architectures to identify zero-day evasive malware.
features: Detection of packed & obfuscated malware samples
RAM memory dump & PE header feature extraction
Evaluated using Random Forest, XGBoost & SVM classifiers
projects.zahid: Analyzes memory dumps to classify evasive, obfuscated malware variants.

projects.name: Botnet Attack Detection System
projects.title: Botnet Attack Detection System
projects.problem: Distributed botnet DDoS attacks overload infrastructure before network administrators can analyze malicious traffic signatures.
projects.fix: Real-time network traffic analysis powered by deep neural networks to identify botnet C2 communication channels and anomaly patterns.
projects.proof: Deep Learning · Network Traffic · Anomaly Detection
projects.longDescription: An intelligent network defense system utilizing deep learning models to analyze live network flow data. Detects botnet command-and-control channels, DDoS floods, and network anomalies before disruption occurs.
features: Automated threat scoring and alert triggers
Deep learning model trained on benchmark network attack traffic
projects.zahid: Monitors network traffic streams to detect and mitigate botnet DDoS threats.

projects.name: Airloop Telemetry & Road Infrastructure Platform
projects.title: Airloop Telemetry & Road Infrastructure Platform
projects.problem: Manual pavement condition inspection across large transportation networks is time-intensive, subjective, and delays critical rehabilitation planning.
projects.fix: Enterprise geospatial GIS platform synchronizing HD video telemetry, GPS coordinates, and AI distress detections across 16,600+ road segments to automate ASTM D6433 PCI scoring and PKR 179B+ M&R budget forecasting.
projects.proof: Leaflet GIS · ASTM D6433 · Synced Telemetry
projects.longDescription: An enterprise-grade geospatial road asset management and automated pavement inspection platform. Indexes 1,260+ roads and 16,616 segments across 21 districts, analyzing 628,000+ AI-detected pavement distresses with synchronized HD video telemetry and automated ASTM D6433 Pavement Condition Index (PCI) budget forecasting.
features: Dual-mode interactive Leaflet GIS with 7-tier ASTM D6433 PCI rating and deep links
Frame-synchronized HD inspection video playback with HMAC-signed tokenized streaming
Automated PCI deduction curves and M&R budget forecasting (PKR 179.85B calculated)
Role-based access control (RBAC), bcrypt auth, and audit telemetry logging
projects.zahid: Transforms 628K+ computer vision detections into spatial ASTM PCI analytics and maintenance planning.
